report:
Reviewed the complete body-independence claim, all eight ordinary implementation associations, and the sole associated TODO test. Additional function-CST and resolver source used to assess the boundary was captured. No production or test source changes were made.

The claim requires checked interfaces containing types, binders and parameter environments without checking the referenced definition body or reading function-body semantics. LocalFnSym::sig opens the function CST but traverses generics, owner interface, parameters/receiver, return type and predicates; it never dereferences cst.body or calls LocalFnSym::body. open_owner consumes trait/impl signatures, preserving owner generic parameters and predicates. The separate body query calls sig in the opposite direction. LocalTraitSym::sig constructs the Self binder and explicit generics, lowers header predicates and completeness, and does not traverse method bodies or associated item values. LocalImplSym::sig similarly lowers its self type, trait reference, generics and predicates without invoking associated method bodies. Associated-item enumeration is a separate operation.

CheckGenerics in cst/generics.rs mints/binds header parameter identities. TypeCst::check in cst/ty.rs recursively lowers declared type syntax, resolves identities and retains aliases; external ADT applications use declaration signatures/defaults and contribute their parameter environments rather than checking implementations. check/trait_env.rs lowers generic bounds and where clauses, references trait signatures for eligibility, and records explicit unsupported state when representation is incomplete. Check::complete_parameter_env combines declared and type-use predicates/eligibility into the interface. The captured resolver traverses symbols/imports and metadata and contains no function-body checking call; the new generated-root ambiguity audit does not introduce one.

external_fn_signature in external_syms.rs obtains RawFnSignature through the keyed metadata method and lower_fn_signature constructs a stash-owned binder with owner/method generics, receiver, argument/return types, parameter predicates and eligibility. Its lowering helpers translate raw declared types and definition identities; they do not request local bodies. This includes the changed external declaration metadata support in the captured file. Unsupported metadata remains flagged, not filled in by body checking.

Important boundary: LocalFnSym stores a combined FnCst containing a body pointer. Reading its tracked CST can therefore conservatively invalidate/reexecute a signature query after a body-only syntax edit, even though sig does not traverse the body. This source review does not claim the stronger property that the signature query never reexecutes after any body edit. The claimed body-independent result and consumer reuse require the explicit incremental verification below. No body-check dependency was found in the inspected query paths.

The sole test semantic_spec::todo::checking_signature_body_independence explicitly defers local/external query traces excluding bodies and a body-only edit preserving signature output and consumer reuse. That missing test matrix remains visible; no no-op test or passing unrelated compile test proves these negative-dependency/incremental guarantees. Completing it requires traces of selected interface queries, checking that body queries are absent, and controlled body edits followed by interface equality and consumer reexecution assertions. There are no N/A entries. This review executes start/read/record only and claims no new behavioral tests. All current implementation entries are accounted for, with the existing TODO preserving the empirical gap. No new required edits identified.
